newsitem.title: USA: Burr-Brown sees return of 15-20 pct growth.
newsitem.headline: Burr-Brown sees return of 15-20 pct growth.

text.p: Burr-Brown Corp on Thursday said it had growing confidence that its annual revenue growth rate was returning to 15 to 20 percent.

"Our confidence is increasing that (an) inventory correction which occurred last year is now finished and that we have returned to the 15-20 percent annual growth rarts more consistent with those of the end markets we serve," the company said in a statement accompanying its first-quarter earnings.
Earlier, the semiconductor company said its profit fell to $0.26 per share from $0.46 a share in the year-ago quarter. Sales fell to $54.8 million from $61.2 million one year ago.
Earnings, however, were up sequentially from $0.23 a share in the fourth quarter and exceeded analysts' mean estimate of $0.24 a share, according to First Call.
"Our first-quarter operating profit ratio is at the highest level in over a year," said Syrus Madavi, the company's chief executive officer.
Burr-Brown said new order bookings had risen significantly from the previous quarter and the year-ago quarter, led by orders from Southeast Asia and the United States.
Sales for all product lines had climbed sequentially, with digital audio and communications products increasing the most.
